description: Land Acquisition - Thennekumbura, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District and Batugammana, Monaragala D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
